facts.fact: The catalogue page says the ten-year Tanzania Digital Economy Strategic Framework 2024-2034 was 'launched' on 29 July 2024 and notes a separate document states the President launched it; no cabinet or parliamentary act is named.

The page gives the strategy's period as 2024-2034 (ten years), published by the Ministry of Information, Communication and Information Technology on its ictc.go.tz site, so the stated period has not ended; its imprint carries no month. Text public: yes

systems.tiers: the framework is anchored to it

note: Class left empty for the framework: the page calls it a 'national digital economy strategy' with a presidential foreword but does not itself describe its scope. It is a catalogue page for the held PDF, so the launch date is the page's own statement, not the strategy's text.
